image_description: A group of people, including children and adults in colorful traditional or folk costumes (pink, orange, blue dresses), are dancing around a tall wooden pole (maypole) in a grassy field. Colorful ribbons extend from the top of the pole to the dancers' hands. In the background, there is a wooden structure with a thatched roof and trees.
